steps.name: Fold
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
node tools/gen/gen-changelog.mjs --check
npm run -s fold | tee fold.log
if git diff --quiet -- CHANGELOG.md docs/changelog.d; then
  echo "nothing to fold"; exit 0
fi
node tools/gen/gen-changelog.mjs --check
cat fold.log >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
git config user.name "apex-changelog-bot"
git config user.email "noreply@anthropic.com"
git checkout -B bot/changelog-fold
git add -A CHANGELOG.md docs/changelog.d
git commit -m "chore(changelog): fold docs/changelog.d fragments

$(cat fold.log)"
git push --force-with-lease origin bot/changelog-fold
PR_TITLE="chore(changelog): fold docs/changelog.d fragments"
PR_BODY="Scheduled fold: $(cat fold.log). Opened by .github/workflows/changelog-fold.yml, which dispatched ci.yml on bot/changelog-fold for this head. CHANGELOG: no player-facing change (this PR moves existing entries)."
# A REFUSED PR FAILS THE JOB (audit4 D1 / audit3 #5, 2026-10-26). This was
# `|| echo ::warning::`, so run 40343209239 pushed the branch, could not
# open the PR ("GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull
# requests") and ended GREEN, every day. Now the job opens (or comments
# on) one issue naming the branch, still dispatches the branch's CI, and
# exits 1. The cure is the repo setting "Allow GitHub Actions to create
# and approve pull requests" (DECISIONS #10, Bryce applies it) or a hand PR.
# https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_issue_create
if gh pr create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --base claude/f1-game-project-26h3ng --head bot/changelog-fold \
  --title "$PR_TITLE" --body "$PR_BODY" 2> pr.err; then
  PR_OK=1
else
  PR_OK=0; cat pr.err
fi
# A GITHUB_TOKEN PR starts no CI; a workflow_dispatch always does (header).
gh workflow run ci.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref bot/changelog-fold \
  || echo "::warning::ci.yml dispatch failed; dispatch it on bot/changelog-fold by hand"
if [ "$PR_OK" = 0 ]; then
  export ISSUE_TITLE="fold PR needs a hand (bot/changelog-fold)"
  NOTE="The scheduled changelog fold pushed \`bot/changelog-fold\` ($(git rev-parse --short HEAD)) but \`gh pr create\` was refused: $(head -1 pr.err). Open the PR from \`bot/changelog-fold\` by hand (its ci.yml run was dispatched), or enable Settings > Actions > General > \"Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests\" (DECISIONS #10). Run: $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
  NUM="$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 100 --json number,title --jq '[.[] | select(.title == env.ISSUE_TITLE)][0].number // empty')"
  if [ -n "$NUM" ]; then gh issue comment "$NUM" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "$NOTE"
  else gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$ISSUE_TITLE" --body "$NOTE"; fi
  echo "::error::fold PR not opened: $(head -1 pr.err) — see the issue \"$ISSUE_TITLE\""
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Cancel queued / running pull_request runs on this branch
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Every live status the List-runs API accepts; pending/waiting/requested
# runs hold a concurrency slot too (#2266 taught queue-depth the same).
# https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs#list-workflow-runs-for-a-repository
for st in queued in_progress pending waiting requested; do
  gh api -X GET "repos/$REPO/actions/runs" -f branch="$BRANCH" -f event=pull_request -f status="$st" -f per_page=100 \
    --jq '.workflow_runs[] | "\(.id) \(.name)"' | while read -r id name; do
    [ "$id" = "$SELF" ] && continue
    echo "cancel $id ($name)"
    gh api -X POST "repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$id/cancel" >/dev/null || echo "  (already finishing)"
  done
done

steps.name: Plan the slices for this diff
steps.run:
set -u
PLAN="${RUNNER_TEMP:-.}/node-plan.sh"
BASE=""; WHY=""
if [ "$CALLED" = "true" ]; then
  BASE="${LIVE_BEFORE:-}"; WHY="a Pages call: the live commit is the base"
elif [ "$EVENT" = "pull_request" ]; then
  # The test commit's first parent, not the event's base.sha, which
  # lags one sync behind it (tools/ci/ci-pr-base.sh).
  BASE="$(bash tools/ci/ci-pr-base.sh "${PR_BASE:-}")"; WHY="a pull request (event base.sha ${PR_BASE:-none})"
elif [ "$EVENT" = "push" ]; then
  if [ "$(bash tools/ci/base-green.sh "${PUSH_BEFORE:-}")" = green ]; then
    BASE="${PUSH_BEFORE:-}"; WHY="a deploy push whose previous tip was gated green"
  else
    echo "the previous tip ${PUSH_BEFORE:-?} is not known green: every script runs"
  fi
fi
if [ -n "${BASE:-}" ] && git cat-file -e "${BASE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "plan base: $BASE ($WHY)"
  node tools/ci/node-plan.mjs --since "$BASE" --sh > "$PLAN"
  node tools/ci/node-plan.mjs --since "$BASE"
else
  node tools/ci/node-plan.mjs --all --sh > "$PLAN"
  echo "no gated base for this $EVENT: every script runs"
fi

steps.name: Pure-node unit suites
steps.run:
# ONE SLICE PER RUNNER (matrix.slice). Every script stays on its own
# line: deploy.mjs and twinned-specs.mjs read this step's text.
# `planned <script>` is the plan step's predicate (true on every
# non-PR event); a skip prints SKIPPED <script> and the reason.
# matrix.needed=false (deploy push / train rows): the name still
# reports for the Pages reuse check, but no work runs for a
# slice this diff does not select.
if [ "${{ matrix.needed }}" = "false" ]; then
  echo "SKIPPED slice ${{ matrix.slice }} — not selected for this diff (needed=false)"
  exit 0
fi
. "${RUNNER_TEMP:-.}/node-plan.sh"
case "${{ matrix.slice }}" in
  vm-a1)
    # The Node VM harness: js/game.js headless, exact parity with the
    # physics baseline (tests/unit/physics-characterization-vm.test.mjs).
    # elevation-tracks-vm builds 40 circuits; each arm builds every
    # other one (APEX_CIRCUIT_SHARD, tools/lib/circuit-scope.cjs), on
    # top of the plan's APEX_CIRCUITS when the diff is circuit-only.
    export APEX_CIRCUIT_SHARD=1/2
    if planned test:game-vm-a; then
    npm run test:game-vm-a
    fi
    unset APEX_CIRCUIT_SHARD   # the shard scopes the elevation twin only; riders see the whole roster
    # RIDERS (2026-10-15): the ten former `fast`-slice scripts used to
    # ride vm-b1, "the shorter half" of 2026-09-30. Measured on three
    # green ship pushes 2026-10-15 (docs/notes/CI-CLOG-SURVEY-2026-10-15.md
    # §7) they were 180 s on top of a game-vm-b1 that alone is 437 s, so
    # vm-b1 set the wall at 10–12 min. They now sit on the three light
    # rows, greedy by median: here net-unit 33 s, audio-unit 33 s,
    # state-unit 5 s, desktop-unit 0.5 s beside a 112 s shard. Still
    # always-on (never guarded by planned()); on a matched PR plan
    # NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF=1 thins tooling-fast overlap via run-group;
    # the `npm run` else-branch stays for gateNodeSuites / deploy.
    # onlyHere files never drop (docs/notes/CI-CAPACITY-2026-09-29.md).
    # tools/ci/pick-unit-slices.mjs SLICE_SCRIPTS mirrors these arms and
    # its test pins the two in step.
    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:net-unit --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:net-unit
    fi
    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:audio-unit --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:audio-unit
    fi
    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:state-unit --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:state-unit
    fi
    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:desktop-unit --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:desktop-unit
    fi
    ;;
  vm-a2)
    export APEX_CIRCUIT_SHARD=2/2
    if planned test:game-vm-a; then
    npm run test:game-vm-a
    fi
    unset APEX_CIRCUIT_SHARD   # as in vm-a1
    # GATE GAP closed 2026-09-10: five garage files (livery-decal-surfaces,
    # livery-contrast, body-split, cover-legibility, helmets) and three
    # steering files (digital-steer, key-binds, settings-export) were in
    # their groups and in NO gate — not tooling-fast, not this step, so
    # deploy.mjs (which derives its node list from here) never ran them
    # either. garage-unit is the heaviest rider (94 s median on a runner,
    # 2026-10-15: the livery rasters), so it rides the 110 s shard alone;
    # steering-unit (6 s) rides `slow`.
    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:garage-unit --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:garage-unit
    fi
    ;;
  page-a)
    if planned test:vm-page-a; then
    npm run test:vm-page-a
    fi
    ;;
  page-b)
    if planned test:vm-page-b; then
    npm run test:vm-page-b
    fi
    ;;
  slow)
    # The three raster/spawn-heavy car files, out of the edit loop
    # (152 s of the old 315 s tooling-fast; 2026-09-01) and into the gate.
    if planned test:node-slow; then
    npm run test:node-slow
    fi
    # Riders (see vm-a1): steering-unit 6 s, mcp 5 s, service-worker 4 s,
    # lifecycle-unit and agent-contract < 1 s, beside 168 s of node-slow.

    if [ -n "${NODE_PLAN_SKIP_TF:-}" ]; then node tools/ci/run-group.mjs test:mcp --skip-tf; else
    npm run test:mcp

steps.name: Was this head already green as a draft?
Does this diff touch the car parts?
steps.run:
set -u
run_all() { echo "parts=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "RUNNING THE PARTS CENSUS: $1"; exit 0; }
# A pull_request has a base and always had one. The sweeps filter
# below went without it long enough to run the whole fleet on every
# PR (fixed the same day this one was written); the mistake is not
# repeated here.
case "$EVENT" in
  push) ;;
  pull_request) BEFORE="${PR_BASE:-}" ;;
  *) [ "$CALLED" = "true" ] || run_all "event is '$EVENT', not a push, a PR or a Pages call" ;;
esac
# A PR diffs against the test commit's first parent (ci-pr-base.sh):
# the event's base.sha lags one sync behind it.
[ "$EVENT" = pull_request ] && BEFORE="$(bash tools/ci/ci-pr-base.sh "${BEFORE:-}")"
case "${BEFORE:-}" in
  ""|0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) run_all "no comparison base (new branch, first push, or caller omitted input)" ;;
esac
git cat-file -e "${BEFORE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || run_all "base $BEFORE unreachable (force push?)"
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only "$BEFORE" "$GITHUB_SHA") || run_all "git diff failed"
echo "--- changed files ---"; echo "$CHANGED"; echo "---------------------"
PARTS_ERE="$(node tools/ci/geometry-paths.mjs --parts-ere)" \
  || run_all "could not read the parts path pattern out of tools/ci/geometry-paths.mjs"
[ -n "$PARTS_ERE" ] || run_all "tools/ci/geometry-paths.mjs printed an EMPTY parts pattern"
echo "--- parts paths --- $PARTS_ERE"
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -qE "$PARTS_ERE"; then
  echo "parts=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "RUNNING THE PARTS CENSUS: the diff touches a module tools/car/parts-sweep.mjs loads"
else
  echo "parts=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "SKIPPING THE PARTS CENSUS: nothing in this diff reaches the car the sweep photographs"
fi
